name: Plainstrider Meat
summary: Plainstrider Meat is freshly harvested game taken from the flightless birds that wander the plains of Mulgore. For the young tauren coming of age on Red Cloud Mesa, gathering this sustenance serves as both vital winter provisions and a core rite of passage.

sections.title: Sustenance for the Mesa
sections.body: Tauren life is inextricably bound to the land, balancing respect for nature with the practical necessity of survival. On Red Cloud Mesa, the settlement of Camp Narache depends heavily on game hunted from the surrounding grasslands. Plainstrider meat provides essential food reserves for the village when stocks run lean, while the birds' plumage offers material for clothing and ceremonial adornments.

sections.title: A Young Hunter's Trial
sections.body: Hunting plainstriders is one of the initial tests given to youth seeking to earn the tribe's respect. Grull Hawkwind directs hopeful hunters to stalk the swift birds across the mesa, gathering meat and feathers to prove their tracking skills and self-reliance before appearing before his father, Chief Hawkwind.

faq.q: What is Plainstrider Meat used for?
aliases: what do i do with plainstrider meat
faq.answer: Plainstrider Meat is gathered by young hunters on Red Cloud Mesa to resupply Camp Narache's depleted food stores, fulfilling an essential task for Grull Hawkwind.
Grull Hawkwind, son of Chief Hawkwind, asks initiates to hunt the plainstriders of the mesa to replenish the tribe's food supplies and prove their worth as providers.

faq.q: Where can Plainstrider Meat be found?
faq.answer: It is harvested from the flightless plainstriders wandering the grasslands of Mulgore, notably across the rolling hills of Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Why is hunting plainstriders considered important to the tauren?
faq.answer: The tauren hunt both for practical necessity and as a spiritual discipline. Bringing game back to the camp demonstrates respect for the Earth Mother, self-reliance, and the ability to sustain the tribe.

angles.text: For tauren youths stepping out onto Red Cloud Mesa, hunting plainstriders is the first practical step toward winning the respect of Chief Hawkwind and earning the right to walk into Thunder Bluff.
The swift plainstrider offers fledgling hunters an early test of their tracking and marksmanship across the open plains of Mulgore.
